description_raw: H2S gas detector alarm at wellhead cluster found set to silent/bypass mode during routine patrol; no work order raised to restore audible alarm.
External corrosion observed on a process piping elbow near CDU, insulation jacket torn and inspection tag shows date overdue by 6 months.
Cable gland at substation switchgear found cracked with visible insulation exposed; area not cordoned off or tagged out.
Guardrail section on mud pit platform (working height 2.2 m) missing after recent maintenance, no barricade or warning tape installed in its place.
Crane sling for the main deck lift showing frayed strands beyond the discard criteria in the rigging inspection log, still in active use.
Cathodic protection rectifier at Valve Station 2 reading zero output for over a week; corrosion monitoring log shows no follow-up action logged.
Confined space entry permit for produced water tank cleaning issued without a documented gas test result in the last 2 hours as required by procedure.
Flare pilot light monitoring camera at the refinery flare stack found non-functional for 5 days; control room relying on periodic visual walk-checks only.
Forklift battery charging bay found with charging in progress despite the ventilation extractor fan being switched off due to a tripped breaker.
BOP (blowout preventer) function test at the drilling rig found overdue against the scheduled interval, well continuing to be drilled without the test being performed.
Pressure gauge on wellhead choke manifold found with cracked glass face and no isolation valve tested in past 6 months.
Relief valve on production separator found rusted shut during walkdown, unable to lift when manually tested.
Nitrogen purge line for catalyst regeneration found with a damaged check valve allowing possible backflow of hydrocarbon vapor.
Static electricity bonding cable at the blending manifold found disconnected at one end.
Grinding wheel guard on bench grinder found removed; operator observed working without eye protection nearby.
Diesel generator exhaust routed close to a flammable material storage shed with less than 1 m clearance.
Scaffold plank on rig substructure found split and taped over rather than replaced.
Combustible gas detector inside mud logging cabin showing 'sensor fault' error for over 24 hours with no replacement sensor requested.
Helideck firefighting foam monitor found with expired inspection tag and low foam concentrate level.
Mud pump room ventilation fan found seized; room temperature significantly elevated during operation.
Pig launcher pressure gauge and vent valve found with no recent calibration record, launcher opened without confirming zero pressure via a second method.
Metering skid enclosure found with door interlock defeated using tape, allowing access while skid was energized.
Flowline right-of-way found with unauthorized excavation by a third party within 5 m of the pipeline, no OIL representative present.
Compressor vibration monitoring system alarm disabled by operator to avoid nuisance trips during a difficult startup, not re-enabled after startup completed.
Boiler safety valve test overdue by 3 months; boiler continues to operate at full pressure.
Handrail around the aeration tank at ETP found corroded through in one section.
Flammable liquid drums stored in the open yard without secondary containment or spill berm.
Vehicle lift found operating past its annual load-test certification date with no re-test scheduled.
Snubbing unit anchor bolts found loose during pre-job inspection, job proceeding on schedule without torque re-check.
Diesel storage tank at field camp found without a fire extinguisher within the mandated 15 m radius.
Smoke detector in accommodation corridor found covered with tape, apparently to stop false alarms.
Moon pool guard grating found with a missing panel section, unguarded opening over open water.
SCADA leak-detection software flagged as running on an unsupported, unpatched version for over a year.
Remote-operated block valve failed to close fully during scheduled ESD test, left in partially open position afterward.
Tank overfill protection (independent high-high level switch) on Tank 3 found bypassed with a jumper wire during a previous maintenance activity, not removed.

LPG cylinder filling scale found reading inconsistently, operators compensating by filling 'by feel' rather than recalibrating.
